scope: Step-2 LoRA deployment preflight with precomputed T5 embeddings
summary: The first deployment invocation stopped before model loading because the positive embedding was referenced under the embedding run directory rather than its recorded destination in the composite dataset.
evidence: The controller returned ValueError: positive prompt embedding is missing or empty before spawning distributed model workers.
The embedding result manifest identifies the actual ep060 file under the composite dataset and records SHA-256 33668e0c046bb9fa1b6ae1aaf49be55b4ec9766a6fb0a2477f510176f6a67b6e.
lessons: Deployment commands must consume the embedding path recorded in result.json rather than infer a location from the embedding experiment directory.
limitations: No model was loaded and no video was generated in this attempt.
next_actions: Retry in a new experiment directory with the manifest-recorded positive embedding path.
